title: Time and Timers
description: A countdown offer, an inactivity timeout, relative timestamps, time-of-day content, a debounced search and a throttled button.

clock.title: Time of day
clock.instructions: The greeting changes with the time of day, and the shop is open from Monday to Friday, during office hours only.

shop.weekend: We are closed at weekends. We open again on Monday at {{opens}}.
shop.before-opening: We are closed. We open today at {{opens}}.
shop.after-closing: We closed at {{closes}}. Come back tomorrow.

countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.instructions: The offer expires five minutes after the page loads, and can no longer be claimed.

session.title: Session timeout
session.instructions: After {{warning}} without any mouse movement, click, key press or scroll, a warning appears. If nobody chooses to stay signed in within {{grace}}, the session is signed out.
session.signed-out: You have been signed out because you were inactive
session.warning-body: You will be signed out in {{time}}.

relative.title: Relative timestamps
relative.instructions: Each update shows how long ago it happened, and the text changes as time passes.

debounce.title: Debounced search
debounce.instructions: The search runs {{delay}} ms after you stop typing.
debounce.label: Search cities

throttle.title: Throttled button
throttle.instructions: After a save, clicks on Save are ignored for {{interval}} ms.
throttle.cooling-down: Saved. Clicks are ignored for a moment
